cohort: 50 infants of mothers with GDM and 50 infants of mothers without GDM
finding: Infants of mothers with GDM showed signs of higher pulmonary vascular resistance and lower biventricular function throughout their first year of life compared to infants of mothers without GDM.
mod_finding: This study adjusted for mode of delivery but did not report specific findings related to mode of delivery.
gest_age: 38.9 ± 0.8 weeks for infants of mothers with GDM vs 39.3 ± 0.9 weeks for controls
birth_weight: 3.55 ± 0.49 kg for infants of mothers with GDM vs 3.56 ± 0.41 kg for controls
